intro: Jordan has few natural resources, so its economy relies on services, tourism, phosphates and help from abroad.

chapters.title: How Jordan earns
text: Jordan mines phosphates and potash from the Dead Sea and sells fertilisers. Tourism to Petra, Wadi Rum and the Dead Sea is important, and many Jordanians work in the Gulf.
Unemployment, especially among young people, is high.

chapters.title: Aqaba
text: Aqaba is Jordan's only port and a special economic zone on the Red Sea.
